scope: Eleven primary locomotion/co-design works, mostly hexapod, plus two manufacturer sources. Breadth-first decision review; no new physics or hardware qualification.

papers.title: Blind Hexapod Locomotion in Complex Terrain with Gait Adaptation Using Deep Reinforcement Learning and Classification
papers.access: Publisher abstract; full methods not independently accessed
papers.method: Terrain experts and history-based gait classification
papers.finding: Blind proprioceptive expert selection adapts locomotion across modeled terrain.
papers.transfer_limit: Simulation evidence does not establish physical RS05 torque margin.

papers.title: Decentralized Deep Reinforcement Learning for a Distributed and Adaptive Locomotion Controller of a Hexapod Robot
papers.authors: Malte Schilling; Kai Konen; Frank W. Ohl; Timo Korthals
papers.method: PPO with six local controllers versus centralized baseline
papers.finding: Leg-local learning provides a useful alternative to a prescribed global clock.
papers.transfer_limit: No physical deployment here; decentralized learning is not universally superior.

papers.title: Adaptive Locomotion Control of a Hexapod Robot via Bio-Inspired Learning
papers.authors: Wenjuan Ouyang; Haozhen Chi; Jiangnan Pang; Wenyu Liang; Qinyuan Ren
papers.method: Two-layer CPG with DDPG parameter adaptation
papers.finding: Low-dimensional learned gait modulation can coexist with velocity, acceleration and torque costs.
papers.transfer_limit: Small AX-12 platform and selected gait families do not validate our heavier RS05 robot.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-contact Motion Planning of Hexapod Robots
papers.evidence: Simulation and simplified real stepping-pile experiment
papers.method: PPO foothold/COM planning with transition feasibility
papers.finding: Whole-transition dynamics and kinematics matter beyond reachable endpoints.
papers.transfer_limit: Known terrain/pose and discrete planning are not a demonstrated fast omnidirectional controller.

papers.title: Learning to Walk: Legged Hexapod Locomotion From Simulation to the Real World
papers.evidence: Author-reported simulation and real low-cost hexapod transfer
papers.method: Parameterized gait plus residual; prior-free joint-target comparison
papers.finding: The author explicitly contrasts easier prior-guided learning with the restrictions imposed by that prior.
papers.transfer_limit: Project page accessed; linked Berkeley thesis PDF returned 404. No independent full-thesis or code reproduction.

official_code.status: Official project link resolved; repository content not independently audited

papers.title: Adaptive Gait Generation for Hexapod Robots Based on Reinforcement Learning and Hierarchical Framework
papers.authors: Zhiying Qiu; Wu Wei; Xiongding Liu
papers.evidence: Simulation and real VkHex flat-ground experiments
papers.method: Seven actions: duty factor, five phase offsets, step length
papers.finding: A learned contact schedule can change gait with commanded speed.
papers.transfer_limit: Flat-ground study; platform-specific virtual support depth must not be copied into our contact model.

papers.title: Smart Gait: A Gait Optimization Framework for Hexapod Robots
papers.authors: Yunpeng Yin; Feng Gao; Qiao Sun; Yue Zhao; Yuguang Xiao
papers.method: Model-based trajectory, timing and phase optimization; contact-force QP
papers.finding: Optimize force distribution and gait timing together under actuator and friction limits.
papers.transfer_limit: Not RL; force/energy formulation assumptions and robot mechanics restrict direct reuse.

papers.title: Whole-Body Constrained Learning for Legged Locomotion via Hierarchical Optimization
papers.evidence: Real 30 kg Elspider-Air hexapod and simulation
papers.method: RL joint trajectories with hierarchical whole-body follower
papers.finding: Hard torque and kinematic constraints can be separated from softer motion objectives.
papers.transfer_limit: Needs reliable dynamics, contact estimation and torque execution; no transferable numerical RS05 speed bound.

papers.title: Learning Natural and Robust Hexapod Locomotion over Complex Terrains via Motion Priors based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.method: PPO with optimized motion priors and adversarial style reward
papers.finding: A tripod motion prior can guide learning without requiring literal per-knot playback.
papers.transfer_limit: Different morphology/actuation; the paper cannot establish our best geometry or support count.

papers.title: Design, Modeling and Preliminary Control of a Compliant Hexapod Robot
papers.authors: Uluc Saranli; Martin Buehler; Daniel E. Koditschek
papers.method: Clock-driven dynamic locomotion with compliant legs
papers.finding: Six-legged locomotion does not intrinsically require five feet on the ground.
papers.transfer_limit: Only six actuated DOF and compliant rotating legs; do not transplant its gait to an 18-DOF serial robot.

papers.title: Concurrent Optimization of Mechanical Design and Locomotion Control of a Legged Robot
papers.authors: Krishnamanaswi Digumarti; Christian Gehring; Stelian Coros; Je Min Hwangbo; Roland Siegwart
papers.method: Joint optimization of mechanical design and control
papers.finding: Controller and morphology should be compared together under the same actuator limits.
papers.transfer_limit: Quadruped trotting/bounding result is a co-design principle, not a hexapod femur/tibia optimum.

hardware_sources.title: RS05 User Manual 260713
hardware_sources.access: Original English PDF retrieved and text read; no overload-curve digitization

pages.pdf_10_printed_8: Rated torque 1.6 N m; 70 by 70 mm heat sink condition
pages.pdf_11_printed_9: Rated test at 100 rpm; peak 5.5 N m; no-load 480 rpm ±10%
pages.pdf_12_printed_10: Thermal/overload discussion distinguishes stall from rotating heating

hardware_sources.inference: Retain current 1.6 N m gate pending exact hardware revision and cooling verification; peak is not continuous permission.

hardware_sources.title: Product Information index
hardware_sources.finding: RS05 row lists 1.8 N m rated at 100 rpm, conflicting with the English manual; heat-sink conditions apply.
hardware_sources.resolution: Unresolved primary-source discrepancy; no project torque gate changed.

constraints.name: Requested torque cap
constraints.change_recommendation: Retain. Validate exact revision, torque-speed-current envelope, thermal duty and cooling before any expansion.

constraints.name: Total target change
constraints.classification: Chosen software target limit, not a manufacturer joint-speed rating
constraints.change_recommendation: New versioned sweep may test higher target rates against actual torque/current/acceleration and contact outcomes. No automatic relaxation.

constraints.name: Swing duration
constraints.change_recommendation: Expose cadence/phase or optimize trajectories, not merely compress identical knots.

constraints.name: Retained wave supports
constraints.change_recommendation: Preserve old proof; admit four-support or dynamic alternatives under explicitly new force/contact/stability criteria.

constraints.name: Position residual radius
constraints.change_recommendation: Do not expect it to change contact schedule. Compare a learnable-reference or direct-target branch with equivalent physical limits.

limitations: No published comparison uses our exact C-study morphology, payload, gains and actuator thermal installation.
Prior-free and trajectory-prior approaches are both represented; paper choice does not decide the architecture.
No new trial, torque-cap change, CAD edit, source mutation or policy adoption is part of this review.
Current learned training results are outside this snapshot; numerical local claims are restricted to hashed paired001 and prior CPU evidence.
